course.title: Unit 6 How do you feel?-Part B--【例句】

sentences.content: Your father is ill. He should see a doctor this morning.
sentences.english: Your father is ill . He should see a doctor this morning
sentences.chinese: 你父亲病了。他今天上午应该去看医生。

sentences.content: Don’t be sad. We can go to the zoo next time.
sentences.english: Don't be sad . We can go to the zoo next time
sentences.chinese: 别难过，我们下次可以去动物园。

sentences.content: How does Dad feel now? Not well. Let’s go to the hospital.
sentences.english: How does Dad feel now ? Not well . Let's go to the hospital
sentences.chinese: 爸爸现在感觉怎么样？不太好。我们去医院吧。

sentences.content: If you feel angry, you should take a deep breath and count to ten.
sentences.english: If you feel angry , you should take a deep breath and count to ten
sentences.chinese: 如果你感到愤怒，应该深呼吸并数到十。

sentences.content: You should do more exercise to stay healthy.
sentences.english: You should do more exercise to stay healthy
sentences.chinese: 你应该多锻炼以保持健康。

sentences.content: It’s cold outside. You should wear warm clothes.
sentences.english: It's cold outside . You should wear warm clothes
sentences.chinese: 外面很冷，你应该穿暖和点的衣服。

sentences.content: She has a cold. She should drink more water and have a rest.
sentences.english: She has a cold . She should drink more water and have a rest
sentences.chinese: 她感冒了，应该多喝水并休息一下。

sentences.content: You should not eat too much candy. It’s bad for your teeth.
sentences.english: You should not eat too much candy . It's bad for your teeth
sentences.chinese: 你不应该吃太多糖果，这对你的牙齿不好。

sentences.content: If you’re worried about your homework, you can ask your teacher for help.
sentences.english: If you're worried about your homework , you can ask your teacher for help
sentences.chinese: 如果你担心作业问题，可以向老师寻求帮助。

sentences.content: He should apologize to his friend.
sentences.english: He should apologize to his friend
sentences.chinese: 他应该向他的朋友道歉。
